# REST reference

Every contract API a PocketOne app with its [standard extensions](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/standard) answers, under `/api/_c/<contract>/`. PocketBase's own API (records, collections, auth, files, settings…) is unchanged; see the [PocketBase docs](https://pocketone.dev/docs/pocketbase).

- **Auth:** an `Authorization` header with a superuser's auth token or an [API token](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/tokens). Each operation needs its token scope; a superuser's own auth token passes every scope.
- **Discovery:** `GET /api/_c/remote/v1` says who you are and lists every contract the app offers ([remote/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/remote/v1)).
- **Input:** a JSON body for `POST`, query parameters for `GET`. **Answers** are JSON; streams are server-sent events.
- **Same as the CLI and MCP:** every operation here is also a `pocketone` command and an MCP tool, behind the same checks ([how](https://pocketone.dev/docs/remote)).

## bulkmail/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/bulkmail/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/count` | Says how many recipients an audience reaches, how many of them are suppressed, and a few sample addresses. | `bulkmail:read` | `audience` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/start` | Queues a campaign's recipients and starts sending (Limit &gt; 0: at most that many new recipients). | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string), `limit` (int) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/pause` | Stops sending a campaign; Resume carries on. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/resume` | Carries on sending a paused campaign. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/cancel` | Stops a campaign for good; recipients not yet sent to are dropped. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/preview` | Renders a campaign's message for one recipient (the first in its audience when Email is empty). | `bulkmail:read` | `campaign` (string), `email` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/bulkmail/v1/test` | Sends a campaign's message to one address, marked as a test. | `bulkmail` | `campaign` (string), `to` (string) |

## deploy/v1

Its own API under `/api/_c/deploy/v1/`: see [deploy/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/deploy/v1). Answered by [Deploy](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/deploy) in the standard set.

## mail.feedback/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/mail.feedback/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/_c/mail.feedback/v1/ses` | Takes an Amazon SNS delivery carrying SES bounce and complaint notifications (and confirms the topic subscription). | public | raw body |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.feedback/v1/webhook` | Takes {"type": "bounce\|complaint\|unsubscribe", "email": ..., "campaign": ...} from any provider, with the shared secret in the X-Feedback-Secret header. | public | raw body |

## mail.suppression/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/mail.suppression/v1). Answered by [Bulk Mail](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/bulkmail) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/check` | Says whether an address is suppressed, and why. | `suppression:read` | `email` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/suppress` | Adds an address (or changes its reason). | `suppression` | `email` (string), `reason` (string), `source` (string), `campaign` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsuppress` | Removes an address, so it receives bulk mail again. | `suppression` | `email` (string) |
| `GET /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsubscribe` | Is the page an unsubscribe link opens (?t=&lt;signed token&gt;). | public | `t` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/mail.suppression/v1/unsubscribe` | Confirms the page's form, or a mail provider's one-click POST (List-Unsubscribe=One-Click). | public | raw body |

## oauth/v1

Its own API under `/api/_c/oauth/v1/`: see [oauth/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/oauth/v1). Answered by [Tokens](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/tokens) in the standard set.

## remote/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/remote/v1). Answered by [Remotes](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/remotes) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1` | Says who the credential is, the app's name and URL, and the contracts it offers. | public |  |
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1/status` | Reports whether the app is running, its versions, uptime and mode. | `remote:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/remote/v1/restart` | Restarts the app; requests in flight finish first. | `remote` |  |
| `GET /api/_c/remote/v1/logs` | Streams the app's log: the last entries, then new ones as they're written. (stream) | `remote:read` | `n` (int) |

## restore/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/restore/v1). Answered by [PITR](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pitr) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/restore/v1` | Says what the app's data can be restored to: a window of time (continuous history) or a list of moments (backups), and whether a restore is running. | `restore:read` |  |
| `POST /api/_c/restore/v1/restore` | Puts the app's data back as it was at the given moment, from the latest point at or before it. | `restore` | `at` (time) |

## settings/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/settings/v1). Answered by [Settings](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/settings) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/settings/v1` | Names the extensions whose settings this app's admins can change. | `settings:read` |  |
| `GET /api/_c/settings/v1/get` | Returns one extension's settings. | `settings:read` | `extension` (string) |
| `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/save` | Replaces one extension's settings and applies them. | `settings` | `extension` (string), `values` (json) |
| `POST /api/_c/settings/v1/test` | Checks one extension's settings without saving them (a test write to a bucket, a test message). | `settings` | `extension` (string), `values` (json) |

## tokens/v1

Its own API under `/api/_c/tokens/v1/`: see [tokens/v1](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/tokens/v1). Answered by [Tokens](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/tokens) in the standard set.

## vacuum/v1

[Contract page](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/vacuum/v1). Answered by [Vacuum](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/vacuum) in the standard set.

| Endpoint | What it does | Token scope | Input |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/_c/vacuum/v1` | Says who compacts the app's databases, whether and how often, and how the last run went. | `vacuum:read` |  |
